description: A conversation with a customer or prospect about their situation, problems and interest.
context: A customer discovery or sales conversation. Capture the customer's situation and words, not the pitch.

sections.heading: Customer Context
sections.instructions: Who the customer is, their role, company and situation, as stated in the conversation.

sections.heading: Problems and Pain Points
sections.instructions: The problems the customer described, in their own terms, with severity or frequency when mentioned.

sections.heading: Current Workflow and Tools
sections.instructions: How they solve it today and which tools or workarounds they use.

sections.heading: Reactions and Buying Signals
sections.instructions: Reactions to what was shown or proposed, interest, urgency, budget and timeline signals.

sections.heading: Objections and Risks
sections.instructions: Concerns, objections, blockers and risks the customer raised.

sections.heading: Next Steps
sections.instructions: Agreed follow-ups with owner and date when stated.
